# umami_user (Data Source)

Look up an Umami user by ID or username, for example to add an existing user to a team with `umami_team_member`. Needs an admin authenticated with `username` and `password`, because Umami refuses API keys for users and only admins can look up other users.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Looking up users needs an admin login; Umami refuses API keys for users.
provider "umami" {
  alias    = "admin"
  username = "admin"
  password = var.umami_admin_password
}

variable "umami_admin_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

data "umami_user" "jane" {
  provider = umami.admin
  username = "jane"
}

resource "umami_team" "client" {
  name = "Example client"
}

resource "umami_team_member" "jane" {
  team_id = umami_team.client.id
  user_id = data.umami_user.jane.id
  role    = "team-member"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID (UUID) of the user. One of `id` or `username` is required.
- `username` (String) Username of the user, matched without regard to case. One of `id` or `username` is required.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `role` (String) Global role of the user: `admin`, `user` or `view-only`.
